title: 机场

series.next: Two weeks later, 3 am your time, 小敏 calls. She's crying. You can't tell if it's happy.

setting: The provincial airport, departures. You're flying back abroad. The whole family has come to see you off.

xiaoyi.name: 小姨
xiaoyi.en: 小敏's mother: checking everything twice

steps.narr: You know what she chose. 外公 told you last night, and only you. At the gate, you keep it.

else.narr: You still don't know what she chose. Nobody does.

steps.narr: Departures. Your flight is in an hour.
外公 holds out a jar of his chilli sauce, wrapped in three plastic bags.

steps.en: Take it. You can't get this over there.

say.en: Say goodbye to 外公: take good care of yourself.
say.gloss: 外公, take good care of yourself.
say.tip: 多保重 = take good care: what you say to someone you won't see for a while.

answers: 外公，天热，您多保重身体。
4.gloss: 外公, it's hot. Look after yourself.

say.tip: 常 cháng = often. 会……的 = will, for sure.

answers: 我会常给您打电话的，放心吧。
4.gloss: I'll call you often. Don't worry.

steps.narr: 小敏 pulls you a few steps away from the others.

steps.en: Over there, abroad... are you happy?

say.en: Answer her honestly: happy, but you miss home too.
say.gloss: Happy. But I miss home, too.
say.tip: 想家 xiǎng jiā = miss home: 想 is miss as well as think.

ok.en: That's what I thought you'd say.
When I filled in the form, I was thinking of you.

ok.zh: 你走那么远，还是回来了。
ok.en: You went so far, and you still came back.

answers: 大部分时候开心，可是常常想家。
4.gloss: Happy, mostly. But I often miss home.

say.en: Tell 小敏 you'll be back next year, or ask her to come and visit you.
say.tip: 明年 míngnián = next year. 还回来 = come back again.

alts.en: Or: ask her to come and visit

answers: 我明年暑假还回来，一言为定。
4.gloss: I'll be back next summer. That's a promise.

answers: 等你上了大学，来看我吧。
alts.gloss: Once you're at university, come and see me.

steps.narr: 外公 doesn't wave. He just stands there until you're through security.

steps.en: Somewhere over the ocean, you open the jar of chilli. The whole row can smell it. 🌶️

else.en: Somewhere over the ocean, you find a note from 小敏 in your pocket: 等我。 🌶️
